CLCON No.596 of 2025
Prem Ram ………Petitioner
Vs.
Shri Dheeraj Garbyal and others ………Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. J.S. Bisht, learned S.C. for the State.
3. This contempt petition has been filed under 
Section 12 of The Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 
alleging willful and deliberate contempt of order dated
10.07.2025, passed by Co-ordinate Bench of this 
Court in WPSS No.303 of 2024, Prem Ram Vs. State of 
Uttarakhand and others, whereby the writ petition was 
allowed after setting aside the impugned 
communication dated 08.10.2020 in the writ petition; 
the respondent-State was directed to release the 
pension, gratuity and all other retiral dues to the 
petitioner within a period of two months from the date 
of passing of the order dated 10.07.2025.
4. It is also provided that the petitioner shall be 
entitled to get interest on the gratuity amount as per 
law and he shall also be entitled to get interest @ 6% 
per annum to other amounts that had fallen due on 
his retirement.
5. It is contended by learned counsel for the 
petitioner that the order has not been complied with. 2
6. The matter was taken to SPA No.25 of 2026, 
State of Uttarakhand Vs. Prem Ram and others, and 
the same was dismissed on 26.02.2026 by Division 
Bench of this Court, but still the order has not been 
complied with.
7. Issue notice to the respondents-contemnors
returnable within two weeks.
8. Steps to be taken within three days.
9. List this case on 12.08.2026.
10. In the meantime, respondent-contemnors may 
file response or comply with the order. 
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 20.07.2026
SK
